post.description: You have a business_id_token or Business ID (from search_businesses or a pasted BusinessInformation URL) and need the full registration record.

business_id.description: The registry's public Business ID (270916, B55208 ...). Resolved through a Business ID search first (one more request). Exactly one of business_id_token and business_id is required.

business_id_token.description: The opaque businessID= token from a search result (eOEbRHk0VkE=), or a pasted quickstart.sos.nh.gov record URL carrying businessID=. Exactly one of business_id_token and business_id is required.

200.description:
Read one business record (GET businessinquire/BusinessInformation plus the page's trademarks fragment) by its opaque record token from search_businesses or by its public Business ID: name, Business ID, type, status, creation and formation dates, home-state name, principal office and mailing addresses, citizenship, annual report years, duration, contact fields, NAICS principal purpose rows, principals, registered agent, trade names, trade-name owner and trademarks. Fields the registry shows as NONE, N/A or Not Available are null.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `business_email` | string |  |
| `business_id` | string | The registry's public Business ID. |
| `business_id_token` | string | The opaque record token (businessID= of the record URLs). |
| `business_name` | string |  |
| `business_type` | string |  |
| `citizenship` | string | Citizenship / State of Incorporation as displayed (Domestic/New Hampshire, Foreign/Delaware ...). |
| `corporation_subtype` | string |  |
| `creation_date` | string | Business Creation Date as displayed (MM/DD/YYYY). |
| `creation_date_iso` | string |  |
| `duration` | string |  |
| `filing_history_url` | string | The site's FilingHistory page for this record (input for get_filing_history by URL). |
| `fiscal_year_end` | string |  |
| `formation_date` | string | Date of Formation in Jurisdiction as displayed. |
| `formation_date_iso` | string |  |
| `internal_id` | string | The registry's numeric internal id (hidden hdnBusinessID; the id the Principals page and the detail XHRs use). |
| `last_annual_report_year` | string |  |
| `mailing_address` | string |  |
| `naics` | object[] | Principal Purpose grid rows (NAICS code / subcode), in the site's order; empty when the grid is absent or shows no rows. |
| `name_in_state_of_incorporation` | string |  |
| `next_report_year` | string |  |
| `notification_email` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `phone` | string |  |
| `principal_office_address` | string |  |
| `principal_purpose` | string | Free-text principal purpose; null when the registry shows Not Required or nothing. |
| `principals` | object[] | Principals Information rows as the page lists them (the site's first grid page). |
| `registered_agent` | object | Registered Agent Information; null when the section is absent or every field is empty. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status` | string |  |
| `trade_name_owned_by` | object[] | Trade Name Owned By grid (the owner of a trade-name record): Name \| Title \| Address; empty when the page lists no owner. |
| `trade_names` | object[] | Trade Name Information grid: trade names registered to this business (observed on record 66740); empty when the page says no trade names are associated. |
| `trademarks` | object[] | Trademark Information rows from the page's GetBusinessTrademarks fragment; empty when it says No records to view. |

post.description: You know (part of) a New Hampshire business name, a Business ID (270916, B55208 ...) or a filing number and need the business's status, type, registered agent, address or the opaque record token that get_business and get_filing_history take.

match.description:
Name match mode (business_name only): Starts With (default), Exact Match, Contains or All Words.

Provider reference: allowed values ["starts_with", "exact", "contains", "all_words"]; default "starts_with".

page.description:
1-based results page (25 rows per page). Later pages are reached by replaying the search and paging the grid in the same session; each page costs its own requests.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 99; default 1.

query.description: Business name text (search_by business_name), a Business ID of up to 9 letters and digits (search_by business_id) or a filing number of up to 10 digits (search_by filing_number).

search_by.description:
Which registry search to run: Business Name (default), Business ID or Filing #.

Provider reference: allowed values ["business_name", "business_id", "filing_number"]; default "business_name".

similar_sounding.description: business_name only: tick the site's 'Show me similar sounding business names' box.

sort_by.description:
Grid column to sort by (the site's own sortable columns).

Provider reference: allowed values ["business_id", "business_type", "principal_office_address", "registered_agent_name", "status"]; default "business_id".

sort_dir.description:
sort_dir

Provider reference: allowed values ["asc", "desc"]; default "asc".

200.description:
Search the New Hampshire business registry (POST businessinquire/BusinessSearch) by business name (starts with, exact, contains or all words), by the registry's Business ID or by a 10-digit filing number, optionally sorted, one page of the results grid at a time (25 rows per page, exactly as the site lists them: one row per current or previous name). A search that matches nothing is a successful empty page (total 0).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Rows on this page. |
| `items_from` | number | 1-based index of the first row on this page as the pager states it; null when nothing matched. |
| `items_to` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number | Page returned, as the grid's pager states it. |
| `page_count` | number | Pages available for this search as the pager states it (0 when nothing matched). |
| `query` | object |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total` | number | Total rows the pager reports (current-name and previous-name rows together). |
